title: KOSPI triggers circuit breaker as chip stocks crash
en: South Korea's KOSPI plunged more than 8% in early trading on Friday, triggering a 20-minute circuit breaker for the first time in about nine months. The benchmark later recovered part of the loss to close down 6.02% at 5,059.69, its lowest close since March, bringing the weekly decline to 11.7%. Memory-chip heavyweights led the rout, with SK Hynix tumbling 10.44% and Samsung Electronics falling 6.35%, as fears over AI spending spread from Wall Street to Asia. Foreign investors sold about 2.77 trillion won of shares. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il convened an emergency meeting, and regulators relaxed margin-loan collateral requirements for three months to prevent forced selling.
zh: 周五早间，韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）暴跌逾8%，触发约九个月来首次熔断，全市场暂停交易20分钟。该基准指数随后收窄部分跌幅，收跌6.02%报5059.69点，创3月以来最低收盘点位，本周累计下跌11.7%。存储芯片权重股领跌，SK海力士大跌10.44%，三星电子下跌6.35%，对AI支出的担忧从华尔街蔓延至亚洲。外资抛售了约2.77万亿韩元的股票。韩国财长李炯一召开紧急会议，监管机构放松融资抵押品要求三个月，以防止强制平仓。
vocab: n. 熔断机制（股市暂停交易措施）
n. 融资贷款（保证金贷款）

title: Hot US jobs report lifts December rate-hike odds
en: The US economy added 165,000 jobs in October, the Labor Department reported on Friday, far above the 59,000 economists had expected and the biggest gain since March. The unemployment rate slipped to 4.1% from 4.2%, while average hourly earnings rose 0.4% month over month and 3.1% from a year earlier, both beating forecasts. Hiring was led by professional and business services, which added 70,000 jobs, followed by health care with 42,000. Following the release, futures markets priced in a roughly 77% chance of a quarter-point rate hike at the Federal Reserve's December 9 meeting, with the policy rate currently at 3.75% to 4.00%.
zh: 美国劳工部周五公布，10月非农就业新增16.5万人，远超经济学家预期的5.9万人，创3月以来最大增幅。失业率从4.2%降至4.1%，平均时薪环比上涨0.4%、同比上涨3.1%，均好于预期。专业和商业服务业新增7万个岗位居首，医疗保健新增4.2万个紧随其后。数据公布后，期货市场定价美联储12月9日会议加息25个基点的概率约为77%，当前联邦基金利率为3.75%至4.00%。

title: China delivers second homegrown large cruise ship
en: China's second domestically built large cruise ship, Adora Flora City, was officially delivered in Shanghai on Friday, marking a key leap from a single-ship breakthrough to serial construction. The vessel is 341 meters long, about 17.4 meters longer than the first ship, and its gross tonnage has increased by 6,400 tonnes to 141,900 tonnes. It offers 2,130 guest cabins and can carry up to 5,232 passengers at full capacity, with construction efficiency improving by 20 percent compared with the first ship. Adora Flora City will sail from Shanghai on November 9, arrive at the Nansha International Cruise Home Port in Guangzhou on November 12, and launch its inaugural season on November 22, focusing on southern China and Southeast Asian routes.
zh: 中国第二艘国产大型邮轮"爱达·花城号"周五在上海正式交付，标志着中国大型邮轮从单船突破迈向系列化建造的关键跨越。该轮总长341米，比首艘船长约17.4米，总吨位增加6400吨至14.19万吨；拥有客房2130间，满载可搭载5232名乘客，建造效率较首艘提升20%。"爱达·花城号"将于11月9日从上海启航，11月12日抵达广州南沙国际邮轮母港，11月22日开启首个航季，聚焦华南与东南亚航线。

title: TSMC eyes 3D DRAM production at Nvidia's request
en: TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, has begun drafting plans to produce 3D DRAM, a new type of advanced memory chip, at the request of Nvidia, its biggest customer, according to people familiar with the matter. The initiative is led by the vice president in charge of advanced packaging, and the company is weighing whether to build new factories or convert an existing plant. 3D DRAM stacks memory cells vertically to pack in more capacity, and the move would put TSMC in direct competition with memory giants Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron. Memory prices have been soaring as AI data centers absorb supply, and Micron expects the shortage to last into 2028.
zh: 据知情人士透露，全球最大芯片代工厂台积电应最大客户英伟达的要求，已开始制定生产3D DRAM——一种新型先进存储芯片——的计划。该项目由负责先进封装业务的副总裁牵头，公司正在权衡新建工厂或改造现有工厂两种方案。3D DRAM通过垂直堆叠存储单元来提升容量，此举将使台积电与三星、SK海力士、美光等存储巨头正面竞争。随着AI数据中心吞噬供给，存储芯片价格持续飙升，美光预计短缺将持续到2028年。

title: Russia-US-Ukraine talks set for Abu Dhabi
en: Russian President Vladimir Putin confirmed on Friday that three-way talks between Russia, the United States and Ukraine on the war will be held in Abu Dhabi on November 10. Ukraine's foreign minister said Kyiv has listed its priorities for the meeting: security guarantees, de-escalation in the Black Sea, an energy ceasefire, the return of Ukrainian children and prisoner exchanges, though he does not expect a breakthrough. He also urged Europe to be fully involved in any peace process. Meanwhile, President Zelensky said Ukraine would continue striking Russian oil refineries in response to Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, which have left multiple regions without power.
zh: 俄罗斯总统普京周五确认，俄美乌三方乌克兰问题会谈将于11月10日在阿布扎比举行。乌克兰外长表示，乌方为此次会谈列出的优先议题包括：安全保障、黑海局势降级、能源停火、遣返乌克兰儿童和交换战俘，但他不指望会谈取得突破。他还呼吁欧洲全面参与任何和平进程。与此同时，泽连斯基表示，作为对俄军打击乌克兰能源基础设施的回应，乌方将继续打击俄罗斯炼油厂，多地已因空袭陷入停电。

title: AI giants' valuations squeezed as market swings
en: The historic AI trading rout is squeezing Wall Street's most anticipated listings and funding rounds. OpenAI has completed an $11 billion funding round at a valuation of $1.25 trillion, down from earlier plans that valued the company at as much as $1.5 trillion, with initial capital commitments received on Friday. Anthropic, which plans to launch its IPO roadshow next week aiming to list before Thanksgiving, now faces investor valuation expectations of $1.2 trillion to $1.3 trillion, some 35% to 40% below earlier hopes of up to $2 trillion. OpenAI's chief financial officer said the company will keep investing in AI data centers regardless of election results.
zh: 史无前例的AI交易巨震正在挤压华尔街最受瞩目的上市与融资计划。OpenAI已按1.25万亿美元的估值完成110亿美元新一轮融资，低于此前最高1.5万亿美元的计划，初始资金承诺已于周五到账。计划下周启动IPO路演、争取在感恩节前上市的Anthropic，目前面临的投资者估值预期为1.2万亿至1.3万亿美元，较此前最高2万亿美元的预期低约35%至40%。OpenAI首席财务官表示，无论选举结果如何，公司都将继续投资AI数据中心。
